regime.label: Stress returns after relief rally
regime.summary: About 12:00 ET: S&P 500 -1.0%, Nasdaq about -2.2 to -2.6%, Dow +0.5%, VIX about 28. WSJ and Bloomberg report new US tariffs on China, the EU and others may come this week. 5-year auction 13:00 ET (22:00 Dubai). Dell, HP, Workday, Autodesk tonight; PCE Wed 17:30 Dubai; US closed Thu.

brief: Chips keep falling (Nvidia -8%, ADI -16 to -19%) and a report of sweeping new US tariffs weighs on markets, with the VIX near 28. No lab trade, no rocket, no new order today: hold Nvidia and keep the $78.50 SPYM limit.

todo.focus: VIX about 28. No lab trade, no rocket, no new order. Hold Nvidia.

items.text: Open the Radar. No lab trade or rocket today: VIX about 28, above our 25 limit
Nvidia about -8% today ($151.21 at midday): HOLD. No add, no sell
Richemont: no CFR order before Fri close. Hermes must stay above EUR 1,225.50 (now about 1,247)

cards.name: EVENT: Nvidia brings back Huang as CEO
cards.trigger: HOLD. Do not chase. Review only if the SEC files charges, Nvidia restates or cuts its growth guide. No lab trade while VIX is above 25.
cards.story: A relief rally inside a correction: Nvidia is still about 20% below a month ago and the probe is open. A Dec 9 Fed hike is still priced.

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: WAIT. Keep the limit BUY 6 SPYM at $78.50, good till Wed Dec 9. Do not raise it: VIX is back near 30. If not filled after the Fed, a new limit on Dec 10.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. 3.5% below its high after a -3% month.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order today. After the Fri Nov 27 close: BUY 2 at CHF 168 or that close, whichever is lower, only if Hermes holds above EUR 1,225.50 and CFR closed above CHF 160.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. It trades $316.89 (-5.8%), near its Nov 20 low of $310.61. Reconsider only after 2 closes in a row above $330, then red team first.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), full-year guide raised. 29% below its high at about 22x next year's profit.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit filled. WAIT on a second slice until the 2027 capex figure (early Feb) and search growth of at least 12%.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. The Oct 29 profit miss was partly an $8.7B one-off investment loss.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. Fell 6-10% today with European chips, far under EUR 48.50. Reconsider only after 3 closes in a row above EUR 48.50 and no US chip export rule hits Europe.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips, but the cash flow guide is below hopes. The drop is chip-sector mood.

cards.name: Microsoft
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order now. After the Fed decision (Wed Dec 9): BUY 1 with a limit at $460, only if VIX is below 25 and MSFT has not closed below $440.
cards.story: Revenue grows about 19% with Azure +48%. But bookings fell and capex is about $170B a year, so buy only lower.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT. The old EUR 235 limit may have filled (SU traded EUR 232.15); if not, cancel it. No new order before full-year results (late Feb 2027); then BUY 2 at EUR 224.
cards.story: Organic growth +16.9%, record backlog, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal financing, not slower demand.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: WAIT. BUY 1 only after a close above $385, with a limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Analog Devices
cards.trigger: WAIT. No buy before Fri Nov 27 (half day). Reconsider only if ADI closes above $337 on both Wed and Fri, VIX is below 25 and no broker cuts; red team first.
cards.story: Record quarter, but EPS is guided down about 6% on flat sales at about 30x earnings. Down about 17-19% today: mixed, not mood.

cards.name: Software AI fear: Salesforce, SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Salesforce reports Wed Dec 2. SAP: reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027) only if cloud backlog growth stays above 25%. Dassault: AVOID.
cards.story: SAP trimmed its 2026 profit guide in July and support revenue fell 5%. Mixed, not a pure mood drop.

cards.name: European chips: STMicro, ASML
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. STMicro: reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027) only if back above EUR 39. ASML, ASMI: after Q4 results. Infineon: see its card.
cards.story: Not a clean mood drop: ASML has rising China exposure, Infineon a weak cash-flow guide. The bounce is fading fast.

cards.name: Cisco
cards.trigger: WATCH. No order. Reconsider only if CSCO closes at or below $87 before Fri Dec 11 with VIX under 25 (red team first); else after the February report.
cards.story: 26-30% below its high after a beat, but services grew only 1% and next quarter is guided lower. Margin fell on memory costs.

cards.name: CrowdStrike buys Zscaler
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Mon closed $208.97, under $210. Reconsider only after the deal filing (S-4) shows Zscaler's numbers and CRWD then closes above $210 for 5 sessions.
cards.story: Fell about 9-10% on an all-stock deal for a slower grower. The quarter is fine but the Q4 guide slows; JPMorgan sees dilution.

cards.name: Aixtron · Xetra
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider only after FY26 results (late Feb 2027) if the 2027 order guide shows laser demand still growing; red team first.
cards.story: Fell about 12% after UBS cut it to Sell. 68% of Q3 equipment orders come from AI laser optics: is 2027 the peak?

cards.name: Demant (Oticon)
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider only after FY26 results (early Feb 2027) if 2027 organic growth is guided at 5% or more; red team first.
cards.story: Business is fine (Q3 revenue +21%, +11% organic), but the long-term growth target was cut: mixed, not mood.

agenda.event: Consumer confidence 19:00 Dubai; Dell, HP, Workday, Autodesk (after close)
US PCE inflation and Q3 GDP 17:30 Dubai; Beige Book; Deere
